items.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing or radiant damage.

items.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning or radiant damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the end of the kuo-toa's next turn.
